_comment.about: The Next.js half of the hosting product (hosting/frappe is the Frappe half since 1.3.0: the rPanel hosting backend, composed by the rPanel Frappe shell, plus the six Hosting Subscription Plan seed records and their Items). Ray, 2026-09-09: hosting is "a seperate frontend for rokctapp, but it points to control site. just hosting focused and filter subscriptions to show only hosting related" - and rokctapp's own storefront filters those same plans out (agent_sdk 1.10.0). hosting/docs/spec.md: rpanel stays a standalone product; for the hosting shell this SDK is a STOREFRONT on the control site plus, since 1.2.0, the signed-in rpanel control pages; there is still no signed-in home. Those control pages compose into the hosting shell, not rokctapp (Ray, 2026-09-26: "rokctai_frontend loses hosting sdk. hosting web app shell gets it"): app/handson/control/rpanel/** (with its own layout.tsx - role gate on HOSTING_ROLES, the nav, the toaster), their actions and services, components/custom/rpanel/**, and what the shell lacked for them - app/services/control/base.ts (ControlBaseService/routeControlCmd over base_sdk's platformCall, pinned to the control site), components/custom/nav/rpanel-nav.tsx (the seven entries injected at its // @rokct-sdk-control-nav-start marker) and the components/ui toast primitive + use-toast hook. There is no app_type.rokctapp block any more; rokctapp does not compose this SDK. It is the hosting shell's home SDK (core/utils/frappe/composer/hosting.json flags it home_sdk: true, beside telemetry_sdk, base_sdk and auth_sdk; no agent_sdk, whose integrations are unconditional and flip the shell AI-first), so it owns app/page.tsx (since 1.4.0 it renders the ROKCT studio home from components/custom/studio/** - every service with its price, two portfolio proofs, the price table in rand at a fixed R18.50 to the dollar with a ZAR/USD switch, the five phases and the WhatsApp line - with its portfolio images installed at public/studio/work/ and, since 1.5.0, the "how we design" section's option thumbnails (four projects - Polaris, South River, Supacharge and the studio itself - options A to C each in light and dark, every one a finished direction in that client's identity rendered from a working page's first screen, the picked one the built site) at public/studio/process/, and its three faces loaded through next/font by components/custom/studio/studio-fonts.ts: Newsreader and Hanken Grotesk from next/font/google, Big Shoulders Display from next/font/local with its four OFL woff2 weights (500-800) under components/custom/studio/fonts/, because next/font/google only carries the newer optical-size Big Shoulders family, whose widths differ; the control-site plans storefront stays at base_sdk's composed /landing; there is no signed-in home to send anyone to) and fills every seam base_sdk's landing host offers with ONE registered module each: components/custom/landing/hosting-hero-copy.ts at // @rokct-sdk-hero-copy-start (base_sdk >= 1.6.0's hero-copy.ts; the three things every plan is sized by cycle as the headline, the trust line states the two facts all six plans share), hosting-hero-form.tsx at // @rokct-sdk-hero-form-start (base_sdk >= 1.7.0's hero-form.ts; two calls to action and no input, as lms-hero-form.tsx: the sign-up and the pricing section - the base hero draws no call to action of its own without a registered body), hosting-features-section.tsx and hosting-pricing-section.tsx at // @rokct-sdk-page-sections-start (base_sdk >= 1.11.0's page-sections.ts; the pricing section declares meta.renders over the prefetched rows so the section and its Pricing nav stop drop together when the control site returns none), hosting-header-menu.ts at // @rokct-sdk-header-menu-start (base_sdk >= 1.14.0's header-menu.ts; two anchors, features and pricing, resolved against the page's live nav; no groups, and no actions because base's header already draws Log in and Sign up; since 1.0.1 brand: { logo: "none" }, base_sdk >= 1.21.0's HeaderMenu.brand - the home SDK declares whether the header shows a logo, Ray 2026-09-09 14:15Z, and hosting has no icon yet, so the header draws the wordmark alone), hosting-site-metadata.ts at // @rokct-sdk-site-metadata-start (base_sdk >= 1.15.0's site-metadata.ts; declares its own SiteMetadataCopy-shaped interface rather than importing base's, as lms and agent do; no icon, so base_sdk >= 1.17.0's generated letter favicon applies), and hosting-plans-query.ts at // @rokct-sdk-plans-query-start (base_sdk >= 1.9.0's plans-query.ts; LANDING_CONFIG.plansQuery with ONE filter laid over its payload, ["plan_category", "=", "Hosting"], the inclusive mirror of agent-plans-query.ts; no plan id or name anywhere in the filter). Their copy is components/custom/landing/hosting-page-sections.ts and the hero and metadata modules; every claim is a fact from hosting/frappe/src/fixtures (plan tiers, website/database/storage sizes, the feature lines, the 14-day trial, USD, monthly and yearly billing) or hosting/frappe/README.md, and nothing a source does not carry is said. Colours route through the shell's theme tokens (bg-primary, text-primary-foreground, the zinc surfaces), never a literal brand colour. The base_sdk floor is 1.21.0 (since 1.0.1): hosting-header-menu.ts declares HeaderMenu.brand, which base_sdk 1.21.0 added, and against an older base the field is unknown to the registry's type and the compose fails to type-check. 1.0.0's floor was 1.19.0: the home_sdk composer (protocol #390) injects only the home SDK's line at the single-answer markers (header-menu, hero-form, plans-query, site-metadata) and base 1.19.0 is the version that shipped with it on the rokctai_frontend refresh; every other registry this SDK targets exists from 1.15.0 (1.17.0 for the generated favicon this SDK relies on by shipping no icon). base_sdk composes first, auth_sdk before this SDK because the landing's sign-up and login links are its routes.

_comment.components/custom/landing/landing-config: installed by base_sdk >= 1.9.0 (LANDING_CONFIG.plansQuery and LandingPlansQuery for hosting-plans-query.ts; planSignupUrl for hosting-pricing-section.tsx)
_comment.components/custom/landing/hero-copy.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.6.0 (the hero copy registry the hosting-hero-copy integration targets; HeroCopy for hosting-hero-copy.ts)
_comment.components/custom/landing/hero-form.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.7.0 (the hero body registry the hosting-hero-form integration targets; HeroFormProps for hosting-hero-form.tsx)
installed by base_sdk >= 1.11.0 (the registry the two section integrations target; PageSectionMeta/PageSectionProps for the section templates; >= 1.11.0 because hosting-pricing-section.tsx declares PageSectionMeta.renders)
_comment.components/custom/landing/header-menu.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.21.0 (HeaderMenu and its brand declaration, the shape hosting-header-menu.ts fills, and the registry its integrations line targets; the registry and the header that renders it exist from 1.14.0, HeaderMenu.brand from 1.21.0)
installed by base_sdk >= 1.15.0 (the site-metadata registry the hosting-site-metadata integration targets; hosting-site-metadata.ts imports nothing from it, so against an older base the installer only skips the line)
_comment.components/custom/landing/plans-query.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.9.0 (the plans-query registry the hosting-plans integration targets)
_comment.app/landing/page.tsx: installed by base_sdk >= 1.5.0 (the composed plans storefront; until 1.3.1 app/page.tsx redirected every visitor here, since 1.4.0 app/page.tsx is the studio home)
_comment.app_type: Since 1.2.0 the manifest carries ONE app_type block, 'hosting' (1.1.0 had a second, 'rokctapp', which installed the rpanel pages into RokctAI_frontend; Ray, 2026-09-26: "rokctai_frontend loses hosting sdk. hosting web app shell gets it", so that block is gone and its installs moved here). 'hosting' is the storefront exactly as 1.0.x shipped it (templates/app, templates/components) plus the rpanel control panel under templates/rpanel/ at their host paths: app/handson/control/rpanel/** (pages and a layout.tsx that gates on HOSTING_ROLES and renders the nav and toaster), app/actions/handson/control/rpanel/**, app/services/control/rpanel/**, app/services/control/base.ts, components/custom/rpanel/**, components/custom/nav/rpanel-nav.tsx and components/ui/toast.tsx + use-toast.ts. The seven Hosting nav entries are injected at the // @rokct-sdk-control-nav-start marker in rpanel-nav.tsx, which this SDK installs itself (the shell has no /handson layout to host it); HOSTING_ROLES and the Remixicon icons are imported there. A rokctapp host is not a persona here, so this SDK installs nothing top-level into one.
_comment.components/custom/back-to-top.tsx: installed by base_sdk >= 1.56.0 (BackToTop with the framed scope and the --back-to-top-* variables; the studio home mounts it inside .st since hosting_sdk 1.7.0). Its look is the studio's own: components/custom/landing/hosting-back-to-top.ts, registered at base's back-to-top-style.ts registry (base_sdk >= 1.56.0), names the studio tokens; studio.css keeps its .st button reset off the button.
_comment.components/custom/landing/back-to-top-st: installed by base_sdk >= 1.56.0: the Back to top style registry; hosting_sdk registers the studio's style there (hosting-back-to-top.ts) since 1.7.0.
_comment.components/custom/site-credit.tsx: installed by base_sdk >= 1.54.0 (SiteCredit, which the studio footer draws since hosting_sdk 1.5.1)
_comment.components/custom/landing/site-credit.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.54.0 (the site credit's rules, imported by site-credit.tsx)
_comment.components/custom/landing/site-shots.ts: installed by base_sdk >= 1.55.0 (the site-shots manifest and image checks app/studio/shots/[site]/[file]/route.ts applies to each client site's /site-shots/). hosting_sdk 1.6.0 therefore needs base_sdk >= 1.55.0
_comment.components/custom/flip-card.tsx: installed by base_sdk >= 1.58.0 (FlipCard, the tutor-card flip lms_sdk drew as LmsFlipCard, moved to base so every shell shares it; the studio portfolio card turns over to its logo process with it, layout="stack"). hosting_sdk 1.8.0 therefore needs base_sdk >= 1.58.0
_comment.app/services/control/base.ts: shipped by this SDK for the hosting shell (in rokctapp the file is host-owned). Same ControlBaseService / routeControlCmd surface as RokctAI_frontend's copy, but over base_sdk's platformCall pinned to the control site (NEXT_PUBLIC_FRAPPE_URL or ROKCT_BASE_URL), because the hosting shell has no app/lib/gateway-rpc.ts and its getControlClient() returns a { app, call } adapter rather than a FrappeApp.
